ValidationRule.description: Not allow Creating Adhoc Request after Status "Waiting for Payment"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
And(
Isnew(), Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "New", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Ticket Sales in Progress", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Request for Ticketing", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Price Approving", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Adhoc Request Approved", Text(Case_ID__r.Status )!= "Adhoc Request Rejected",
RecordType.DeveloperName = "Adhoc_Request"
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Not allow creating Adhoc Request when the case is on the following Status : Adhoc Request Approving, Waiting for Payment, Payment Details Incorrect, Ready for Ticketing, Ticketing Issued.
